_comment: Editor layout for the dye-shape FCS calibration model (DyeShapeFCSModel). The dye is the fixed quantity here — picking it fixes D, so the geometry (w0, s) is what the fit determines and D / tauD / cpm are read-only outputs of it. The parameters live on the model itself, so the tables carry no target.

sections.label: Dye
sections.description: Reference species from MMFDB carrying a diffusion coefficient D(25 °C, water); curate them in the MMFDB admin tool. Type to search — matching is on any part of the name.
N and the baseline b scale the curve; w0 and s are the confocal volume shape this calibration determines. temp sets the water viscosity the dye's D is scaled with.
One global bunching term: amplitude b_a and relaxation time b_t. b_a also sets the dark fraction that separates cpm from cpm_all.
Derived, not fitted: D from the dye and the temperature, tauD from D and w0, and the counts per molecule over the bright (cpm) and all (cpm_all) molecules.
